translationRepairs: Clan and marriage various divisions assembling for the funeral exceeded ten thousand; Mengxun wept and said to the masses: "Formerly when Han's mandate was mid-faint, my great-grandfather aided and encouraged Dou Rong, preserving and quieting the west of the River.

Clan and marriage various divisions assembling for the funeral exceeded ten thousand; Mengxun wept and said to the masses: "Formerly when Han's mandate was mid-faint, my ancestor aided and encouraged Dou Rong, preserving and quieting the west of the River.
乃祖 is an ancestor, not specifically a great-grandfather; ancestor matches the Chinese and the idiomatic field.
Mengxun remonstrated saying: "Returning hosts do not block; exhausted bandits are not pursued—this is the military family's rong.
Mengxun remonstrated saying: "Returning hosts do not block; exhausted bandits are not pursued—this is the military specialists' precept.
The quoted maxim 歸師勿遏，窮寇弗追 is the soldiers' precept; leaving 戎 as uninterpreted rong makes the sentence meaningless.
Ye relied on Mengxun to escape, sighed saying: "I alone could not use Zifang's words, thereby reaching to this!"
Ye relied on Mengxun to escape, sighed saying: "I could not use Zifang's words, thereby reaching to this!"
孤 is Duan Ye's first-person pronoun, not the adverb alone.
Mengxun feared Ye could not contain himself, always hiding wisdom to avoid him.
Mengxun feared Ye could not tolerate him, always hiding wisdom to avoid him.
容己 takes Mengxun as object: Duan Ye might not tolerate him, not that Ye could not contain himself.
Ma Quan, a gentleman attendant at Duan Ye's gate, was dashing and brilliant, with military talent above the common run.
Ma Quan, Duan Ye's Gentleman Attendant of the Chancellery (menxia shilang), was dashing and brilliant, with military talent above the common run.
門下侍郎 is the chancellery office, not a servant posted at a physical gate.
Ye's gatehouse gentleman Ma Quan was handsome and bright with transcendent qi, martial plans surpassing others.
Ye's gentleman attendant of the chancellery Ma Quan was handsome and bright with transcendent qi, martial plans surpassing others.
門下侍郎 is an office, but the proposed Menxia shilang is not natural English; render the title in English.
Mengxun reached Zhangye; Ang's elder brother's son Cheng'ai cut the pass and admitted him; Ye's left and right all scattered.
Mengxun reached Zhangye; Ang's elder brother's son Cheng'ai cut open the gate and admitted him; Ye's left and right all scattered.
斬關內之 means cutting the gate bars to admit him, not a mountain pass or the toponym 關內.

In the fifth year of Long'an, Liang Zhongyong, Fang Lu, Tian Ang, and others proclaimed Mengxun commissioner with full powers, grand commander, great general, governor of Liangzhou, and Duke of Zhangye, granted an amnesty within his domain, and adopted the era name Yong'an.

In the fifth year of Long'an, Liang Zhongyong, Fang Gui, Tian Ang, and others proclaimed Mengxun commissioner with full powers, grand commander, great general, governor of Liangzhou, and Duke of Zhangye, granted an amnesty within his domain, and adopted the era name Yong'an.
晷 is guǐ; Fang Lu does not match 房晷.

In the fifth year of Long'an, Liang Zhongyong, Fang Lu, Tian Ang and others raised Mengxun as commissioner bearing credentials, grand commander, great general, Liangzhou shepherd, Duke of Zhangye, amnestied within his borders, changed era to Yong'an.

In the fifth year of Long'an, Liang Zhongyong, Fang Gui, Tian Ang and others raised Mengxun as commissioner bearing credentials, grand commander, great general, Liangzhou shepherd, Duke of Zhangye, amnestied within his borders, changed era to Yong'an.
The literal field repeats the same wrong reading of 晷 as Lu.

He named his cousin Funu garrison general, governor of Zhangye, and marquis of Heping; his brother Nu general who establishes loyalty and marquis of Dugu; Tian Ang general who guards the south and governor of Xijun; Zang Mohai general who supports the state; Fang Lu and Liang Zhongyong chief clerks left and right; Zhang Zhi and Xie Zhengli majors of the left and right.

He named his cousin Funu garrison general, governor of Zhangye, and marquis of Heping; his brother Nu general who establishes loyalty and marquis of Dugu; Tian Ang general who guards the south and governor of Xijun; Zang Mohai general who supports the state; Fang Gui and Liang Zhongyong chief clerks left and right; Zhang Zhi and Xie Zhengli majors of the left and right.
The same man 房晷 appears among the new appointments and must be Fang Gui.

He appointed elder male cousin Funu as garrison-general, Zhangye governor, marquis of Heping; younger brother Nu as establish-fidelity general, marquis of Dugu; Tian Ang as guard-south general, Xijun governor; Zang Mohai as bulwark-of-state general; Fang Lu and Liang Zhongyong as left and right senior clerks; Zhang Zhi and Xie Zhengli as left and right majors.

He appointed elder male cousin Funu as garrison-general, Zhangye governor, marquis of Heping; younger brother Nu as establish-fidelity general, marquis of Dugu; Tian Ang as guard-south general, Xijun governor; Zang Mohai as bulwark-of-state general; Fang Gui and Liang Zhongyong as left and right senior clerks; Zhang Zhi and Xie Zhengli as left and right majors.
Literal English must use Gui for 晷 here as well.
Moreover I, orphaned and lacking virtue, wisdom not spanning far—yet how can one not think to hear straight words to mirror self!
Moreover I, of meager virtue, my wisdom not spanning far—yet how can one not think to hear straight words to serve as a mirror to myself!
孤 is the ruler's self-reference and 寡德 is meager virtue, not orphaned.
At the time Yao Xing dispatched envoys Liang Fei and Zhang Gou and others to appoint Mengxun general who guards the west, governor of Shazhou, marquis of Xihai.
At the time Yao Xing dispatched envoys Liang Fei and Zhang Gou and others to appoint Mengxun grand general who guards the west, governor of Shazhou, marquis of Xihai.
The title is 鎮西大將軍; dropping 大 under-ranks the office.
Mengxun's paternal uncles central-field guard intimate Qinxin and Linsong governor Kong Du together were arrogant and wasteful, encroaching and harming; the hundred surnames suffered them.
Mengxun's paternal uncles, Central-Field Protector Qinxin and Linsong governor Kong Du, together were arrogant and wasteful, encroaching and harming; the hundred surnames suffered them.
親信 is the uncle's personal name after 中田護軍, not the adjective intimate.
Mengxun took twenty thousand cavalry east and camped at Danling; the northern chieftain Sinan brought three thousand tents to surrender.
Mengxun took twenty thousand cavalry east and camped at Danling; the northern chieftain Sipan brought three thousand tents to surrender.
思盤 is Sipan (盤 pán); Sinan does not match the characters.
Mengxun led twenty thousand horse east to campaign, halted at Dan Ridge; northern barbarian great man Sinan led three thousand tribes to submit.
Mengxun led twenty thousand horse east to campaign, halted at Dan Ridge; northern barbarian great man Sipan led three thousand tribes to submit.
The literal field has the same false Sinan reading of 思盤.
Within a fortnight Nu died; Mengxun then named his kinsman Yizi garrison general of the capital, colonel of the Qiang, and governor of Qin to hold Guzang.
Within a fortnight Nu died; Mengxun then named Yizi, a senior agnate of his grandfather's generation, garrison general of the capital, colonel of the Qiang, and governor of Qin to hold Guzang.
從祖 is a grandfather-generation collateral kinsman, but the proposed parenthetical Chinese is awkward in the idiomatic field.
On the new terrace the eunuch Wang Huaizu struck at Mengxun and wounded his foot; Lady Meng seized the assassin, executed him, and wiped out three generations of his kin.
On the new terrace the eunuch Wang Huaizu struck at Mengxun and wounded his foot; Mengxun's wife Lady Meng seized the assassin, executed him, and wiped out three generations of his kin.
其妻孟氏 refers to Mengxun's wife after 擊蒙遜, not the eunuch's; the antecedent must be explicit.
Within a fortnight Nu died; Mengxun then named his kinsman Yizi garrison general of the capital, colonel of the Qiang, and governor of Qin to hold Guzang.
Within a fortnight Nu died; Mengxun then named Yizi, a senior agnate of his grandfather's generation, garrison general of the capital, colonel of the Qiang, and governor of Qin to hold Guzang.
The literal must restore 從祖 without inserting a Chinese gloss into the English sentence.
Are the host of hopes impure, what spirits condemn?
Are the various sacrificial cults impure, condemned by the spirits?
群望 are the sanctioned cults of mountains and rivers, and 絜 is ritual purity, not hopes.
Chipan sent Qifu Kuini Yin to block him; Mengxun attacked and killed him.
Chipan sent Qifu Tuiniiyin to block him; Mengxun attacked and killed him.
乞伏魋尼寅 is one personal name; splitting it as Kuini Yin invents a word-break the Chinese does not mark.
Mengxun sent Huang Xun to Jin with a memorial: "Heaven has scourged the realm; the empire is broken; the royal sun hangs over the south while the people lie under barbarian hooves.

Mengxun sent the houseman Huang Xun to return the courtesy visit to Yi and submitted a memorial: "Heaven has scourged the realm; the empire is broken; the royal sun hangs over the south while the people lie under barbarian hooves.
The source sends 舍人黃迅 to 報聘益州; the original drops the office and replaces Yi with Jin.
The garrison star now stands in the Scales, yet Liu Yu has destroyed Qin—he too will not long hold the Guanzhong."
The garrison star now stands in Xuanyuan, yet Liu Yu has destroyed Qin—he too will not long hold Guanzhong."
軒轅 here is the asterism Xuanyuan, continuing 軒轅之苗裔, not Libra.
Mengxun agreed, drew back to Jiankang commandery in Hexi, and marched home.
Mengxun agreed, walled Jiankang, and marched home.
城建康而歸 is to wall Jiankang and return; the sentence does not mention Hexi or a mere drawing-back to the commandery.
Mengxun agreed and told Yao Ai and Fang Lu to draft regulations for the court hall.
Mengxun agreed and told Yao Ai and Fang Gui to draft regulations for the court hall.
房晷 is Fang Gui, as elsewhere in the chapter.
Mengxun accepted it, ordered south-conquest Yao Ai and masters of writing left aide Fang Lu to compose court-hall regulations.
Mengxun accepted it, ordered south-conquest Yao Ai and masters of writing left aide Fang Gui to compose court-hall regulations.
The literal field has the same Lu misreading of 晷.
When Lü Guang turned cruel, he avenged the murder of Quzhou;
When Lü Guang turned cruel, he deeply harbored the grievance of Quzhou;
深懷仇粥之冤 is to harbor Quzhou's wrong, not a completed vengeance in this sentence.
